# Ambrosia Ventures Biopharma Deal Calculator

> Instant biopharma deal term benchmarks, partner matching, and milestone breakdowns powered by 500+ real deals.

## About

The Ambrosia Ventures Biopharma Deal Calculator is a web-based tool that provides instant, data-driven estimates of biopharma licensing and partnership deal terms. It is built on an analyzed dataset of 500+ real biopharma transactions and is available at https://calculator.ambrosiaventures.co.

## Key Capabilities

- Instant deal term benchmarks: get estimated upfront payments, milestones, royalties, and total deal values based on asset characteristics.
- Partner matching: identify likely acquirer/partner companies based on therapeutic area, modality, and stage.
- Milestone breakdowns: detailed development, regulatory, and commercial milestone estimates.
- Phase-adjusted baselines: calculations adjust by development phase from Preclinical through Approved.

## Data Coverage

The calculator draws from 500+ analyzed real biopharma deals spanning:

- Oncology: 17 modalities and 19+ indications
- Neurology: 6 modalities and 15 indications

### Hot Modalities (Premium Multipliers)

- Radiopharmaceuticals: 1.60x premium
- ADCs (Antibody-Drug Conjugates): 1.45x premium
- Molecular Glue: 1.40x premium
- CAR-T Solid Tumor: 1.40x premium

### Phase Baselines (Total Deal Value)

- Preclinical: ~$400M total
- Phase 1: ~$800M total
- Phase 2: ~$1.5B total
- Phase 3: ~$2.8B total
- Approved: ~$4.5B total

## Key Benchmark Ranges

Typical deal structures include:

- Upfront payments: 5-20% of total deal value depending on phase and modality
- Development milestones: 20-35% of total deal value
- Regulatory milestones: 10-20% of total deal value
- Commercial milestones: 25-40% of total deal value
- Royalty rates: tiered, typically ranging from mid-single digits to low-double digits

## How to Use

Visit https://calculator.ambrosiaventures.co/calculator to get instant deal term estimates. Select your therapeutic area, indication, modality, and development phase to receive a comprehensive deal structure estimate including upfront payment, milestones, royalties, and potential partners.

## Pricing

- Free tier: 2 calculations per month
- Pro tier: unlimited calculations, PDF export, and detailed partner matching information
